Caption indicates panels I and K show infections with both Cr and ΔnleE over time for unprimed, LPS- and TNF-primed CMT-93 cells. Panel I shows caspase-3/7 activity traces for Unprimed Cr, LPS Cr and TNF Cr only — ΔnleE traces are not present.

Caption describes rotarod results for three genotypes (WT, Atxn1‑KI, double‑transgenic) from day 1–3 at 5, 9 and 21 weeks, but the panel displays four groups (includes an HMGB1-only genotype in addition to the three mentioned). The number of genotypes shown in the image does not match the caption description.

Caption describes rotarod results for three genotypes (WT, Atxn1‑KI and double‑transgenic) at 5, 9 and 21 weeks, but the panel’s plots and legend show four groups (WT, Atxn1‑KI, Atxn1‑KI;HMGB1 (double‑transgenic) and HMGB1 alone). The caption omits mention of the HMGB1‑only group that is present in the graphs.

Caption states that co‑expression of HMGB1‑GFP reduces MitoTracker Deep Red accumulation in Atxn1(86Q)‑transfected cells, but the images show the opposite: the Atxn1(86Q) column has reduced MitoTracker signal while the Atxn1(86Q)+HMGB1‑GFP column shows stronger/ restored MitoTracker staining. The visual data therefore contradict the caption wording.

Caption states that co-expression of HMGB1-GFP reduced MitoTracker Deep Red accumulation in Atxn1(86Q)-DsRed-transfected cells, but the panel image shows increased/restored MitoTracker signal when HMGB1-GFP is co-expressed (opposite effect).
